description:
The gravel bike Eurobike XC580, Equipped with 700C * 35C tires, can adapt to various ground conditions better than road bike and mountain bike.

You can easily change the gears and enjoy the speed excitement with 21 speed shifter.

Dual disc brakes provide stronger and more reliable stopping power, which will help riders keep safe in different terrain and riding conditions.

Large Frame size 54 cm Fits up for taller people between 5'7” to 6'2".Max weight up to 250 lbs.

The package includes free pedals, assembly accessories and debugging tools. 85% of the parts are pre-assembled. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us and we will be at your service at any time.

Product description

YH-XC580 Gravel Bike for Mens 54cm Frame Bicycle 700C Wheels Commuter Bicycles Adult

Leading the retro trend of road bicycles

You may need a bike that is compatible with the advantages of mountain bikes and road bikes.

YH-XC580 road bike equipped with 700C*35C wheels and 21 Speed shifting system, dual disc brakes It is not only suitable for pavement, but also suitable for gravel. Internal Wiring, Easy to clean the bike.

Large bicycles are more suitable for taller people. Frame Size of 56 cm fits up for 5'7” to 6'2".

Cycling is a nice way to keep healthy and make friends with new people.

Let's go cycling together!

Product details

Smooth Drivetrain System

YH-XC580 has a smooth drivetrain system. Shimano three front gears and seven in the rear which ensure a smooth ride.

Dual Disc Brakes System

Front and rear double disc brakes provide a stable response with reliable stopping action in different kinds of weather to makes the journey safer.

Adapt to a variety of terrain

YH-XC580 gravel bike meets people's dual needs of commuting and physical exercise, perfectly integrating into people's urban life.

Stand-over Height

Stand-over Height of YH-XC580 IS 77CM. Frame size of 54 cm fits up for 5'7” to 6'2". Tips:There should be one inch between the top tube and the crotch of the rider when the rider’s feet are in the ground.

Configuration Data

Why choose YH-XC580?

Excellent gravel bike

Lighter and more comfortable

Design for both exerciser and commuter

Makes for a great gift！

Installation Steps

Flip the stem, install front wheel

Install handlebar

Install pedals (Pay attention to the direction of rotation)

Install saddle

Tune the wheels

Tune the brakes, derailleurs

How to assemble this bike?

It needs a few minute.

This bicycle arrives with 85% assembled. You need to install the front wheel, pedals, handlebar, seat and pump up the tires under the guidance of the assembly instructions.

Bicycle assembly instruction is in the package, please read it more carefully before installing the bike and tuning the brake and speed system.

All tools are included in the package. Seriously following the installation instruction to assemble it，your bike will work well！

If it is possible, we recommend bringing it to a local shop for a safety check/tuning by a bike mechanic to riding and at regular intervals thereafter.
